title: The ThesisPro research showcase
notice: 13 original research directions, 12 active topics. These are curated topic cards, not thirteen completed or published theses. Start a new personal paper without importing any private manuscript or result.

entries.title: Designing a Human–AI Hybrid Workplace: An Operating Systems Approach
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: Human judgement, bounded automation and business accountability.
entries.question: How can a workplace assign authority, evidence and responsibility across people and AI?

entries.title: Developmental Artificial Intelligence: Adaptation with Auditable Evidence
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: Prediction complexity must earn its calibration and operating cost.
entries.question: When does adaptation improve on a simple recent-value baseline after all costs are counted?

entries.title: Human Resource Management
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: A foundation for examining workforce practices through explicit evidence.
entries.question: Which workforce practice has a measurable outcome and a credible comparison?

entries.title: Kernel 8: Deterministic Planning and Resource Hints
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: Resource-aware planning with inspectable decisions and bounded costs.
entries.question: When do resource hints change outcomes compared with a deterministic no-hint baseline?

entries.title: Kernel 9: Adaptive Planning and Verifiable Governance
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: Adaptive recommendations constrained by explicit governance.
entries.question: Which adaptations earn their cost without weakening stated resource boundaries?

entries.title: Marketing Management Analysis of Porsche AG
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: An independent strategy research topic, not a company endorsement.
entries.question: How do dated primary disclosures support or challenge an account of marketing strategy?

entries.title: Organizational Behaviour and Technology
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: Technology adoption examined alongside roles, incentives and behaviour.
entries.question: What explains observed adoption outcomes beyond the technology itself?

entries.title: RU’OS X Lava: A Native ARM Mobile Operating System
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: Versioned evidence for capability boundaries and recovery conditions.
entries.question: Which protection and recovery claims survive explicit failure tests on a pinned implementation?

entries.title: Adolescent Wellbeing in Sabah
entries.summary: A topic-only example about family functioning, social support and resilience. No private study or participant records are distributed.
entries.question: How should family, support and resilience relationships be evaluated without overstating causal evidence?

entries.title: Tamil Time Continuum: Scheduling and Deadline Tradeoffs
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: தமிழ் காலத் தொடர்ச்சி. Scheduling research with explicit timing and deadline boundaries.
entries.question: How do calibration history and workload horizon change scheduling tradeoffs?

entries.title: VOIKE: Optical Reliability and Bounded Operating Systems
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: Estimator reliability and proposed OS boundaries are distinct tracks; one does not validate the other.
entries.question: When does an estimator fail under correlated or contaminated observations, and what remains untested physically?

entries.title: VOIKE OS: Kernel Architecture and Bounded Services
entries.summary: A preserved conceptual track now grouped under VOIKE. This card does not assert authorship of recovered documents or a working implementation.
entries.question: Which service boundaries must be implemented and tested before architectural promises become evidence?

entries.title: ZeniOS: Immutable Architecture and Governed Extensions
entries.author: Ilangkhumanan Thirunavokkarasu
entries.summary: A new research foundation around mutation and extension boundaries. Recovered-document authorship is not established by this card.
entries.question: What is immutable, who can authorise an extension, and how is recovery demonstrated?
